notes.title: Balance patch 0.7.10

notes.title: Early Access Release Slightly Delayed
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone,

Quick update — the Early Access release is going to be a bit later than planned. The build is ready, but I’m waiting for Steam’s review process to finish, and unfortunately that’s out of my hands.

I’m aiming for next week, but since the timing depends on Steam, I can’t give a hard date just yet. As soon as the game is approved, I’ll hit the release button right away.

Thanks for your patience — we’re almost there![/p]

notes.title: Early Access Release Date
notes.notes:
[p]Heу everyone!
[/p][p]I am happy to announce that the Early Access launch is planned for August 22, 2025.[/p][p]At the moment, I have finished porting the game to the new engine (Godot 4.3), during which the following was done:[/p][list][*][p]New PvE and PvP game modes[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to create a lobby and adjust the difficulty level[/p][/*][*][p]Added looting mechanics (containers with loot all over the map and loot items, with the ability to sell them)[/p][/*][*][p]Completely reworked character animations[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked and improved game effects (flying shells, gunpowder gases, explosions, impact effects, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated dynamic lighting (sunlight, more realistic surface lighting)[/p][/*][*][p]Completely new netcode (P2P using Steam Networking Sockets), this has improved the situation with desyncs/lags during the match[/p][/*][*][p]Updated character action system and added multiple QoL improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Added 60 Steam achievements and fully integrated the Steam ecosystem into the game[/p][/*][*][p]And more[/p][/*][/list][p]As a result of this transition, I was also able to rework many parts of the code, so it will be much easier to make changes to the game. More details on the changes will be described after the Early Access release.[/p][p][/p][p]Early Access Goals:[/p][list][*][p]Add content to the game (maps, modes, equipment, factions, quests)[/p][/*][*][p]Fix various bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Improve game balance[/p][/*][/list][p]It will be much easier and more effective to do this with real feedback from players. So I hope for your help to make the game better :)[/p][p][/p][p]Gameplay Teaser: [dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/RDIful7WFu4"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Why late 2024 release is not possible?
notes.notes:
Hello, friends. I created this post to notify those who care about the fate of this game that the release is postponed indefinitely.
To understand the reasons for this decision, let's look at the history of this game. I started active development around 2019, then spent about four years creating what some of you might have seen in the demo version. All this time, I essentially financed myself so that I could study tools, practices, and concepts at a comfortable pace for myself. But now I do not have this opportunity and I needed to shift my focus to work (IT). Although I continued to work on Lost Lives, I did not have time to bring it to a high-quality look by the end of 2024.
Although I could have made a release "for the sake of it", I chose to finish the game with a shift in the release date. Now the game is in the process of switching to a new version of the Godot engine, which has significantly improved character animations, lighting, reworked part of the game code, and improved the multiplayer. I really hope that soon I will be able to return to full-fledged development of the project with new knowledge, experience and strength!

P.S. Forgive me, please, who was waiting for this release.
